description: Logical actor aliases for scenario execution. UPN resolution is deferred to runtime configuration; no credentials, secrets, or actual UPNs are stored here.

actor_aliases.description: Primary test user identity used as the source / sender of scenario actions. Expected to hold licenses required for the scenarios it performs (e.g. Exchange Online, OneDrive, Teams).
Secondary test user identity used as the recipient / target of scenario actions. Identical license profile as primary actor.
Optional tertiary test user identity for scenarios that require a third peer. Reserved for future expansion; not currently bound to any scenario in the catalog.

notes: Aliases are logical only. Actual UPN object ids and credentials are resolved at runtime by the future integration layer.
No passwords, secrets, tokens, or actual UPN strings are stored in this file.
No administrator accounts are modeled as ordinary scenario actors.
test-user-01 is reserved as the primary actor; test-user-02 is the canonical peer; test-user-03 is reserved.
